title: Frontline Education Data Breach Impacts Over 1.3 Million
description: Frontline Education experienced a data breach impacting over 1.3 million individuals, including school district staff and students. The breach occurred due to exploitation of a vulnerability in third-party software, allowing unauthorized access to Frontline's environment. Stolen data includes sensitive personal information such as names, Social Security numbers, dates of birth, government ID numbers, health insurance details, and student IDs. The breach was contained within one day, and Frontline has notified affected individuals and school districts. The company is providing free credit monitoring and identity theft protection services to affected adults and dark-web monitoring for qualified minors.
